name: dark
description: A sleek dark theme for tech blogs and night reading.
author: Mortar Team
custom_css: body { background: #0f172a; color: #e2e8f0; } header, footer { background: #0f172a !important; border-color: #1e293b !important; } article h2, article p, aside h3, aside a, .widget-title { color: #e2e8f0 !important; } article { border-color: #1e293b !important; } aside .rounded-lg { background: #1e293b; border-color: #334155 !important; } input, textarea, select { background: #1e293b !important; border-color: #334155 !important; color: #e2e8f0 !important; } .text-gray-500, .text-gray-600, .text-gray-400 { color: #94a3b8 !important; }
